title: Hong Kong & Japan — May/June 2026
description: Three weeks across Hong Kong, Tokyo, Atami, Hiroshima, and Kyoto — Michelin dim sum, ryokan onsen, DisneySea, the Peace Memorial Museum, and a farewell wagyu dinner in Osaka.

days.notes: Late arrival (~9pm) on CX 801. Airport Express to Kowloon Station, then free K3 shuttle to Hotel ICON. Short walk to Kai Kai Dessert for a late-night first taste of Hong Kong.

activities.name: Arrive Hong Kong (CX 801)
activities.description: Clear customs, take Airport Express to Kowloon Station, then free K3 shuttle to Hotel ICON. Check in ~10:30pm.

activities.name: Kai Kai Dessert
activities.description: Michelin Bib Gourmand dessert stall open until 1am (113–115 Parkes Street, Jordan). Black sesame soup and tofu skin with ginkgo.

days.notes: Full day: Michelin dim sum at Yat Tung Heen, cable car and Buddha on Lantau, golden-hour cocktails at Ozone, and late Cantonese dinner at Above & Beyond.

activities.name: Ngong Ping 360 Cable Car & Tian Tan Buddha
activities.description: MTR to Tung Chung, then cable car up to Ngong Ping plateau. Visit the giant bronze Tian Tan Buddha and the Wisdom Path. Leave Lantau by 4:30pm for Ozone.

activities.name: Ozone Bar — Ritz-Carlton ICC
activities.description: World's highest bar at the Ritz-Carlton ICC Tower. Golden hour and harbour sunset views. Smart casual; children under 12 allowed before 9pm. Confirmation: HKGKW-6ZPDX34SFV5D.

activities.name: Symphony of Lights (optional)
activities.description: Free nightly harbour laser and light show from the TST waterfront. Tight after Ozone — consider catching on May 26 or 28 instead.

meals.notes: Michelin one-star at the Eaton Hotel, Jordan. Traditional Cantonese dim sum since 1990. Confirmation: #73HUHAZSBJBA.
28th floor Cantonese restaurant at Hotel ICON with panoramic harbour views. Open until 11pm. Book via hotel or OpenTable.

days.notes: Hong Kong Island day: Star Ferry to Central, Michelin roast goose at Yat Lok, Victoria Peak, and the Hollywood Road / Man Mo Temple / SoHo corridor.

activities.name: Star Ferry — TST to Central
activities.description: Classic 10-minute harbour crossing from Tsim Sha Tsui Pier to Central.

activities.name: Victoria Peak
activities.description: Peak Tram from Garden Road terminus up to the Peak for sweeping harbour and city skyline views. Allow ~2 hours.

activities.name: Hollywood Road, Man Mo Temple & SoHo
activities.description: Walk Hollywood Road to the incense-filled Man Mo Temple, then wander through SoHo's street art scene. Stop at Snack Baby Gelato (2025 Michelin Guide entry).

meals.dish: Roast goose with lai fun noodles
meals.notes: Michelin one-star on Stanley Street. Arrive by 10:45am to queue before 11am opening. Cash only (~HK$150–200/person); expect shared tables.
Convenient dinner at the hotel after a full day on Hong Kong Island. Good positioning for the early departure the next morning.

days.notes: Check out of Hotel ICON by 8am. CX 520 departs 10:40am, arrives Tokyo Narita 4:05pm. Keisei Skyliner to Ueno (~41 min). Evening wander at Ameyoko Market and seafood dinner.

activities.name: Arrive Tokyo Narita (CX 520)
activities.description: Take the Keisei Skyliner directly to Ueno Station (~41 min). Check in to &Here Tokyo Ueno by ~5:30–6pm.

activities.name: Ameyoko Market
activities.description: Lively open-air market right outside Ueno Station — vendors, street food, fresh fish. Follow with a sunset stroll around Shinobazu Pond.

meals.restaurant: 佐渡島へ渡れ (Sadogashima e Watare)
meals.dish: Fresh oysters and seasonal sashimi from Sado Island
meals.notes: Seafood izakaya specializing in Niigata coast seafood and local sake. All private room seating, ~¥4,000–5,000/person, 3-min walk from JR Ueno Station. Reserve on Tabelog.

days.notes: Early Senso-ji and Yanaka, then Skytree and a deep-dish Tokyo day. Sukiyaki dinner at the century-old Ningyocho Imahan.

activities.name: Sensō-ji Temple, Asakusa
activities.description: Arrive before the tourist buses for the full atmospheric experience — incense drifting through the great gate, Nakamise-dori quiet and hushed.

activities.name: Yanaka Neighborhood
activities.description: One of Tokyo's best-preserved shitamachi neighborhoods. Walk Yanaka Ginza shotengai, the atmospheric cemetery, and stop at a local kissaten for coffee.

activities.name: Suzukien Matcha Gelato
activities.description: Famous for 7-level matcha gelato in ascending intensity. Hanakawado Street — order Level 7.

activities.name: Tokyo Skytree
activities.description: Panoramic views across Tokyo. Book tickets in advance (window opens April 30 for May 30). Browse Solamachi shopping complex at the base.

activities.name: OKACHI Beer Lab
activities.description: Craft beer and grilled meat 5-min walk from the hotel. Low-key, convivial end to the day.

meals.notes: Casual yakitori lunch near Ueno. No reservation needed.
Sukiyaki institution since 1895. Server cooks wagyu tableside; drag each slice through raw egg yolk. Book in advance at imahan-tokyo.com; 10% service charge applies.

days.notes: Meiji Jingu and Harajuku in the morning, then a Yokohama day trip for Cup Noodles Museum and the Shin-Yokohama Ramen Museum.

activities.name: Meiji Jingu Shrine & Yoyogi Park
activities.description: Forested shrine grounds — serene in early morning. Follow with Yoyogi Park and Takeshita Street for the full Harajuku street fashion spectacle.

activities.name: AMAM DACOTAN Bakery
activities.description: One of Tokyo's most celebrated bakeries, known for extraordinary sourdough and pastries. Opens 11am — pick up something for the Yokohama journey.

activities.name: Cup Noodles Museum, Yokohama
activities.description: Minato Mirai waterfront. Highlight is the My CUPNOODLES Factory — design your own personalized cup with choice of soup and toppings. Walk-in on a numbered ticket system.

activities.name: Yokohama Red Brick Warehouse
activities.description: Beautifully restored 1913 port warehouses with open waterfront park and cafe terraces. A relaxed 30-min pause before the ramen museum.

activities.name: Shin-Yokohama Ramen Museum
activities.description: Underground recreation of a 1950s Tokyo backstreet housing 9 ramen shops from distinct regional styles. Order mini (ko) portions to try 3–4 styles. ¥380 admission.

days.notes: Early Tsukiji morning, Ginza browse, teamLab Borderless at 2pm, then Shinjuku for ramen dinner.

activities.name: Tsukiji Outer Market
activities.description: Walk the stalls: coffee at Turret Coffee, tamagoyaki at Marutake, eel skewers at Nisshin Tasuke, mochi at Solatsuki. Walk-and-eat style.

activities.name: Ginza & KITTE Marunouchi
activities.description: Melon pan at Ginza Kimuraya, Mitsukoshi Ginza basement food hall, and TRAVELER'S FACTORY STATION near Tokyo Station for stationery.

activities.name: teamLab Borderless, Azabudai Hills
activities.description: One of the world's most extraordinary digital art installations. Ticket number AKLYCXFM4YLM-0001. Allow 2–3 hours; large bags must be checked at entrance.

activities.name: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building Observation Deck
activities.description: Free night views, open until 10:30pm. Low-effort panoramic view if energy allows before dinner.

meals.notes: Excellent quality fish from Hokkaido. Opens at 11am; arrive early to beat the lunch queue.
Near Yoyogi, 10 min south of Shinjuku Station. Arrive 4:40–4:45pm to queue before the 5pm dinner opening — among the best tsukemen in Tokyo.

days.notes: Full day at Tokyo DisneySea. Leave hotel by 7:45am to reach the gates by 8:30am (park opens 9am). Priority: Fantasy Springs, Journey to the Center of the Earth, Tower of Terror.

activities.name: Tokyo DisneySea
activities.description: Reservation A00555726363. Priority: Fantasy Springs (Frozen/Tangled/Peter Pan), Journey to the Center of the Earth, Tower of Terror. Buy Disney Premier Access for Frozen immediately after entry.

days.notes: Slow final Tokyo morning in Ueno, then Shinkansen to Atami (~50 min, depart 13:57). Afternoon in Atami town before ryokan check-in and kaiseki dinner.

accommodation.name: Atami Sekaie — Ocean View Suite Tsuki no Michi

activities.name: Anmitsu Mihashi
activities.description: One of Tokyo's oldest traditional sweet shops, serving anmitsu (agar jelly, sweet bean paste, and syrup).

activities.name: 2k540 Aki-Oka Artisan
activities.description: Craft and design shops tucked under the JR train viaduct near Akihabara — last souvenir shopping before leaving Ueno.

activities.name: Shinkansen: Tokyo → Atami
activities.description: Tokaido Shinkansen from Tokyo Station. Depart ~13:57, arrive Atami ~14:42 (~45 min).

activities.name: Atami Ginza & Ieyasu no Yu Footbath
activities.description: Stroll the main shopping street, pick up onsen manju (steamed over hot springs), and soak feet at the free footbath outside the station.

activities.name: Kiunkaku Villa
activities.description: Beautifully preserved 1919 villa with Roman-style baths, Art Deco stained glass, and terraced gardens. Closes at 5pm — arrive by 4pm.

activities.name: Check in — Atami Sekaie Ryokan
activities.description: Ocean View Suite Tsuki no Michi. Settle in, onsen soak, and multi-course kaiseki dinner of local Izu seafood.

days.notes: Traditional ryokan breakfast, final morning soak, check out by 11am, and Shinkansen to Hiroshima (~4h 15min). Arrive mid-afternoon; gentle wander and Grill Hikoboshi dinner.

accommodation.name: Sheraton Grand Hiroshima — King Bed, Club Lounge

activities.name: Ryokan Breakfast & Final Onsen
activities.description: Traditional breakfast — grilled fish, rice, pickles, miso soup. Final morning soak. Check out by 11am.

activities.name: Shinkansen: Atami → Hiroshima
activities.description: Hikari from Atami to Shin-Osaka, transfer to Sakura to Hiroshima. ~4h 15min total. Pick up an ekiben bento at Atami Station.

activities.name: Hondori Covered Shopping Arcade
activities.description: Gentle introductory wander through Hiroshima's lively pedestrian main street. Sheraton is directly connected to Hiroshima Station.

meals.dish: Omurice and hamburger steak with demi-glace
meals.notes: Tiny ten-seat counter in the Hondori district. Book as early as possible on Tabelog — this is one of the harder reservations on the trip.

days.notes: Dedicated Hiroshima history day: Peace Memorial Museum and Park in the morning, Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki for lunch, and the castle and Orizuru Tower in the afternoon.

accommodation.name: Sheraton Grand Hiroshima — King Bed, Club Lounge

activities.name: Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum & Park
activities.description: Allow at least 2 hours in the museum — among the world's most significant and moving. Walk the Park: A-Bomb Dome, Children's Peace Monument, and cenotaph. Photography not permitted in main exhibition halls.

activities.name: Hiroshima Castle (Rijōkaku)
activities.description: Postwar reconstruction on original foundations with an intact moat. Interior museum of Hiroshima history (45 min).

activities.name: Hiroshima Orizuru Tower
activities.description: Contemporary architecture near Peace Park with observation deck and the origami crane drop installation — a meaningful coda to the day's themes.

meals.notes: Three-story building with ~25 vendors. Walk in, point at what looks good, watch it cook in front of you. Hiroshima-style is layered — noodles, cabbage, egg, and meat stacked on the griddle.

days.notes: Full day on Miyajima Island: Itsukushima Shrine, Daishoin Temple, fresh grilled oysters for lunch, and the ropeway up Mount Misen. Check tide times before departure.

accommodation.name: Sheraton Grand Hiroshima — King Bed, Club Lounge

activities.name: Miyajima Island — JR Ferry from Miyajimaguchi
activities.description: JR Sanyo Line to Miyajimaguchi (~25 min), then 3-min walk to the ferry terminal. JR Ferry ~10 min to the island. Aim for first or second ferry to arrive by 8:30am.

activities.name: Itsukushima Shrine & Floating Torii Gate
activities.description: Walk the waterfront to the shrine built on stilts over the water — extraordinary at high tide. Check tide times for your visit. Walk to the far side for a quieter vantage.

activities.name: Daishoin Temple
activities.description: One of the island's most impressive Buddhist temples — far less crowded than the shrine. Stone lantern-lined paths, spinning prayer wheels, and profound quiet.

activities.name: Momijidani Park & Miyajima Ropeway
activities.description: Walk through maple-forested Momijidani Park, then take the ropeway partway up Mount Misen for panoramic Inland Sea views (~¥1,000/adult each way).

activities.name: Momijido Main Store — Momiji Manju
activities.description: Pick up maple leaf cakes (red bean, custard, or matcha) from Momijido Main Store on Omotesando Street — the quintessential Miyajima souvenir.

meals.notes: Both celebrated Miyajima oyster specialists. Try grilled, with cheese and lemon, or in oyster rice. Arrive by 11:30am to beat the lunch rush.

days.notes: Light Club Lounge breakfast, check out by 11am, final okonomiyaki at Hiroshima Station Ekie food hall, then Nozomi Shinkansen to Kyoto (~1h 40min). Arrive ~1:15pm.

accommodation.name: Hotel Kanra Kyoto — Suite Main Building

activities.name: Shinkansen: Hiroshima → Kyoto (Nozomi)
activities.description: Nozomi Shinkansen from Hiroshima Station. ~1h 40min. Arrive Kyoto ~1:15pm.

activities.name: Higashi Honganji Temple
activities.description: Spectacular free-entry Jodo Shinshu Buddhist complex next door to Hotel Kanra — one of Japan's largest wooden structures. Perfect low-key first Kyoto stop.

activities.name: Gion Evening Walk
activities.description: Walk Hanamikoji Street and the quieter backstreets of Gion Shinbashi — Kyoto's most atmospheric district of stone lanes and wooden machiya townhouses.

activities.name: Yamaneko Gion Craft Beer and Sake Bar
activities.description: Excellent craft beer and sake in the Gion neighborhood. Low-key nightcap after an arrival day.

meals.notes: Several solid okonomiyaki counters open from the morning inside Hiroshima Station. Final taste of Hiroshima before the train.
Beloved casual izakaya in the Gion backstreets — grilled skewers, tofu dishes, pickles, local sake. Book ahead on Tabelog; small and fills up.

days.notes: Full day in Arashiyama: early bamboo grove, Tenryu-ji garden, shojin ryori lunch at Shigetsu, and a refined tempura omakase dinner back in Gion.

accommodation.name: Hotel Kanra Kyoto — Suite Main Building

activities.name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
activities.description: Arrive early — the only way to experience it without wall-to-wall crowds. Walk through into Tenryu-ji UNESCO World Heritage Zen temple with one of Kyoto's finest pond gardens.

activities.name: Togetsukyo Bridge & Arashiyama Shops
activities.description: Wander the craft shops and riverside path along the famous Togetsukyo Bridge. Stop at Boulangerie Rauk for an afternoon snack before heading back to central Kyoto.

activities.name: Kyoto Beer Lab
activities.description: Nightcap after dinner — excellent craft beer selection.

meals.notes: One of Japan's finest shojin ryori restaurants inside Tenryu-ji's grounds. Seasonal vegetables, tofu, and mountain ingredients. Set menus from ~¥4,000/person. Book well in advance.
Refined tempura counter in the Gion area. Book in advance on Tabelog or directly.

days.notes: Day trip to Nara: Todai-ji Great Buddha, freely roaming sacred deer, Kasugataisha Shrine, and the Naramachi preserved merchant district.

accommodation.name: Hotel Kanra Kyoto — Suite Main Building

activities.name: Kintetsu Limited Express: Kyoto → Nara
activities.description: From Kintetsu Kyoto Station directly to Kintetsu Nara (~45 min). Buy tickets in advance.

activities.name: Tōdai-ji & Nara Park Deer
activities.description: The Great Buddha Hall — largest wooden building in the world, housing a 15-meter bronze Buddha. Sacred deer roam freely in Nara Park. Also visit Kōfuku-ji and its five-story pagoda.

activities.name: Nakatanidou Mochi Pounding
activities.description: High-speed mochi pounding demonstration on Sanjo Dori. Eat warm yomogi mochi right on the spot.

activities.name: Kasugataisha Shrine
activities.description: One of Japan's most sacred Shinto sites, lined with roughly 3,000 stone and bronze lanterns along forest paths. Loop back through Naramachi's preserved merchant district.

activities.name: Salon Naramachi Cafe
activities.description: Tea in the preserved old merchant district. Also stop at Maedano Donut for celebrated inventive donuts.

meals.notes: Browse the Naramachi district cafes and snack stalls for a light lunch between Kasugataisha and the afternoon tea.
Casual ramen dinner back in Kyoto after the Nara day trip.

days.notes: Osaka day trip: Tower Knives for Sakai blades, Kuromon Ichiba market, Dotonbori street food, Shinsaibashi shopping, and a special wagyu farewell dinner at Steak Ron.

accommodation.name: Hotel Kanra Kyoto — Suite Main Building

activities.name: Travel to Osaka
activities.description: JR Tokaido Line from Kyoto Station to Osaka Station (~28 min) or Hankyu Limited Express from Kyoto-Kawaramachi (~42 min).

activities.name: Tower Knives Osaka
activities.description: Specialist knife shop in Shinsekai carrying Sakai-made blades. Multilingual staff, duty-free with passport, test knives before buying, name engraving available.

activities.name: Kuromon Ichiba Market & Namba Yasaka Shrine
activities.description: Osaka's famous covered market with fresh fish, grilled skewers, and street food. Walk to Namba Yasaka Shrine to see the extraordinary giant lion-head stage.

activities.name: Dotonbori & Namba
activities.description: Takoyaki at Wanaka or Aizuya, then dumplings at Chao Chao Gyoza. Keep it light — save appetite for Steak Ron.

activities.name: Shinsaibashi & Amerikamura
activities.description: Walk the centuries-old covered Shinsaibashi-suji arcade, then wander into Amerikamura for vintage stores, street art, and independent cafes.

meals.notes: The most special dinner of the trip — a proper farewell to Japan. Counter seats and open kitchen. Reservation number: Q5HTXRSNH8.

days.notes: Early Kiyomizudera at dawn, Nishiki Market browse, check out by 11:30am, Haruka express to KIX, CX 507 to Hong Kong (arrives 8:50pm). Final night at Skycity Marriott.

activities.name: Kiyomizudera Temple
activities.description: Opens at 6am and nearly deserted in early morning — the wooden stage over the waking city is breathtaking. Walk down through Ninenzaka and Sannenzaka stone-paved lanes on the way back.

activities.name: Nishiki Market
activities.description: Kyoto's narrow covered food market — graze through pickles, tofu, wagashi sweets, and edible souvenirs. Most stalls open by 10am.

activities.name: Haruka Limited Express: Kyoto → KIX
activities.description: From Kyoto Station, arriving Kansai International Airport ~1:30pm. CX 507 departs 5:35pm. Seat reservation required.

activities.name: Arrive Hong Kong (CX 507)
activities.description: Skycity Marriott is directly connected to Terminal 1 — seamless final-night check-in.

days.notes: CX 806 departs 12:10pm Hong Kong, arrives Chicago O'Hare 1:55pm. Journey complete.

activities.name: Fly Home — CX 806 HKG → ORD
activities.description: CX 806 departs Hong Kong 12:10pm, arrives Chicago O'Hare 1:55pm.
